messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Password reset failure blocks access",
 "problem_statement": "Users are locked out of the claims portal because they cannot reset their passwords. This prevents them from accessing critical documents and dashboards needed to serve policyholders.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "I need to reset my password for the claims portal — can you guide me through it?",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-08T16:12:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "I need to reset my password because I can’t access the documents section for policyholders.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-12T13:43:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "I think my login credentials expired. Can you help me reset them?",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-08T16:12:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "I’m locked out of our claims portal and need to reset my password urgently.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-25T13:47:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "I need to reset my password ... I’m locked out of the claims dashboard and can’t access policyholder documents.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-13T12:54:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard anymore.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-25T13:47:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "I need to reset my password for accessing the claims portal — can you guide me through that?",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-29T10:48:00+00:00"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The title claims password reset 'failure' blocks access, but every quote is a straightforward request for guidance on resetting a password ('can you guide me through it?'), with no evidence that the reset flow itself is broken. One quote suggests expired credentials, which points to account/credential handling rather than a product defect, and a help article or support walkthrough would answer these requests. No quote describes an error, broken reset link, or product flaw a squad could act on.", "verdict": "fail"}
